narrative_text: An employee was working on the rig floor while setting a casing when the employee lost balance and placed the left hand on the casing. At the same time, the casing slips were released and the inter-tool slid down, amputating the employee's left index finger at the first knuckle.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative_text: An employee slipped and twisted his right ankle while attempting to carry a 50-pound bag of seed, fracturing his fibula and tibia.
event_title: Slip without fall, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was approximately 1 foot high on an uneven surface, removing the cross-over pin from a casing collar, when the employee slipped on the uneven surface and fell to the ground. The employee fractured the first four vertebrae.
event_title: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet

narrative_text: An employee had just replaced a rubber O-ring on a manifold and was trying to put the bull plug back on the missile when it slipped off and took the employee's hand down, striking it against the flat metal plate below. As a result, the employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.
event_title: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

narrative_text: An employee was standing on the rig floor watching another employee operate a set of power tugs when the tugs slipped and rotated, hitting the employee. The employee was knocked from the rig floor and struck the ground. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg and right wrist.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: While conducting well-servicing operations, an employee was setting up the work floor of a workover rig. The employee slipped on loose dirt, causing him to lose his grip on the wing portion of the rig floor. The wing portion fell, landing on his left ring finger and amputating the fingertip.
event_title: Struck by object or equipment, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was walking in the company kitchen when she slipped on water and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee was cutting 3/4-inch strips of wood with a table saw when a piece of scrap wood became stuck between the guard and the saw blade. As the employee attempted to remove it, the left index fingertip contacted the blade and was partially amputated.
event_title: Struck against moving part of machinery or equipment

narrative_text: An employee was about to go down a flight of stairs but noticed someone coming up the same stairs. He then re-directed to go to another set of stairs but tripped and fell. He shattered his left elbow and was hospitalized.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over self

narrative_text: An employee was removing a clamp from the cable on the swivel. The decking had been removed and the employee was standing on the beam. The employee slipped and fell, landing on the surface casing valve. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was performing rigging operations at a well pad. He was walking on a containment pad walkway that was slippery from a recent rain/snow event. He slipped and fell. He attempted to catch himself during the fall and fractured his left wrist. He was hospitalized.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: While climbing into construction equipment, an employee slipped and fell onto an operating handle, suffering a broken left rib and punctured lung.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee slipped on water droplets on the floor and fell, breaking her left hip and right ankle.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee was exiting a truck when he lost his footing while descending the cab stairs. He fell to the ground and injured his left elbow, requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: A workover crew was tripping out of a hole when the drill line parted, causing the blocks to drop from 10 to 15 feet up and fall onto the floor. The drill floor sprung up when the blocks contacted it, throwing an employee off the floor. He fell approximately 15 feet onto the ground, breaking a rib.
event_title: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet

narrative_text: An employee was operating a pulling unit on a rig when he tripped on a pipe, fell,  and broke his leg.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative_text: An employee was performing maintenance on the frac pump and was using a pry bar to roll the pump for re-packing. The pry bar slipped and struck the employee's head. He then fell striking his head on the ground and sustained a concussion.
event_title: Fall on same level, n.e.c.

narrative_text: On or about August 31, 2016, an employee was disconnecting drill pipe joints in the rig and slipped and fell. The drill pipe joint came down and struck his right hand middle and index fingers.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: Two employees were carrying a drill bit and installation tool to the center of a drilling rig floor. One of them slipped and fell, and the drill bit and installation tool landed on his left hand. He suffered an open fracture and partial amputation of the last joint of the little finger, as well as a laceration to the ring finger.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slip or trip

narrative_text: An employee was checking around a work area. The employee tripped on a ground rod that was sticking up about 2 inches from the ground and suffered a broken left knee.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative_text: An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot. He injured his knee and required surgery.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: The injured employee was overseeing that the rod connections were going well. A work crew was coming out of the well with 1.5-inch, fiberglass rods and double stands. They had just made the connection. An approximately 60-foot fiberglass rod unscrewed from the holding, slipped out of the transfer, fell out of the barrack, and hit the rig floor. It then bounced off the rig floor onto the ground and struck the injured employee on the left side of the head, knocking him unconscious.
event_title: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

narrative_text: Employees were pulling slips while running drill pipe in a well bore. An employee suffered a hernia.
event_title: Overexertion in pushing, pulling, or turning, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was slipping pipe when it became stuck and the pipe snapped, striking the employee in the back and ribs. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
event_title: Struck by dislodged or detached object(s)

narrative_text: An employee tripped and fell while walking across a rig floor, suffering multiple fractures to the left elbow.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was rigging up a swab lubricator when he tripped on an uneven surface and broke his tibia and dislocated the fibula.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping on uneven surface

narrative_text: An employee was installing a rear suspension airbag beneath a hydro-excavation truck when the airbag slipped off the truck's frame and struck him in the face. The employee sustained multiple facial fractures and an intraparenchymal hemorrhage and was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck by propelled, falling, or suspended object  unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was working on the rig floor and tripped over an object that he just placed on the rig floor falling to the ground. The employee landed on his shoulder fracturing an arm and dislocating his elbow.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative_text: An employee was changing the belts on a pumping unit. The employee left one bolt in place and held the 40-pound guard up with his shoulder. The guard slipped from his shoulder and lacerated his bicep, requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Struck by swinging or slipping object, other than handheld, n.e.c.

narrative_text: Two employees were installing plastic on a strainer basket inside of a reactor 30' high when the basket slipped and pulled in one employee's glove and middle finger. Approximately 1/4" of the employee's left middle fingertip was amputated. The basket is made of steel and is shaped like a small garbage can measuring 2' x 1.5' and weighing 200 pounds.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative_text: An employee was walking to his truck when he slipped in the mud and hit his head and back, suffering a concussion and spinal fracture.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee was lacing up the line with paper when he lost his balance and fell to the floor, breaking his foot and ankle. He required surgery.
event_title: Fall on same level, n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was walking back to the work area, slipped, and fell to the ground fracturing the right tibia and fibula.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee was detaching a 200-pound bale at or near an oil well site. He tripped on a rock and fell backward and the bale fell on his abdomen, causing internal bleeding.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative_text: An employee was standing on top of a pump truck when he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a skull fracture.
event_title: Other fall to lower level  6 to 30 feet

narrative_text: An employee was clearing ice on top of a drilling rig doghouse landing. Hinges broke when the employee jumped to clear the ice, and the employee fell to the ground 20-plus feet below. The employee suffered fractures to the lumbar region, wrist, and ankle.
event_title: Other fall to lower level 21 to 25 feet

narrative_text: An employee was loosening a bullhead when their wrench slipped. The employee fell from his position to the ground, sustaining a lower left leg fracture.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: The employee was walking, tripped over a wooden pallet, and fell breaking his hip.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative_text: An employee broke two bones in his left leg when he slipped in the pea gravel and his leg slid under a cradle that was being used to support and hold in place a steel pipe.
event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping

narrative_text: An employee was using a ratchet wrench to tighten a bolt when the wrench slipped, catching his finger between it and a piece of steel. His left-hand third fingertip was amputated.
event_title: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by injured worker

narrative_text: An employee was holding/monitoring the purging "pigging" of a concrete pumping hose after testing. The hose began flailing and struck the employee in the face, causing face, jaw, cheek, and nose injuries/lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck by swinging or slipping object, other than handheld, n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was changing out a bolt on the kicker (moveable object) on the driller side of the PDS (stationary object) control box on the rig floor. The kicker came down on his right hand, catching it between the kicker and the trough. The employee sustained fractures to his thumb and index finger, as well as lacerations to the top and bottom of his hand.
event_title: Struck by falling part of vehicle or machine, still attached

narrative_text: A discharge hose failed, striking an employee and causing a laceration and fracture of the right tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

narrative_text: A flowback operator was cutting a hole in a 55-gallon poly drum. The knife closed on his left little finger, cutting it. He was hospitalized; the finger was amputated.
event_title: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by injured worker

narrative_text: An employee was replacing the well house. After installing the new well house, the employee drilled a 2- to 3-inch hole in the side of the well house to run a 2-inch pipe. The employee inserted the pipe into the hole and secured it inside the well house. The employee then traveled outside the well house to apply tape onto the threaded section of the new pipe. The employee used his left index finger to hold the tape on the threads. The pipe section inside the well house fell from its support and the employee's finger was lacerated, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
event_title: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was performing abrasive blasting on two six-inch pipes. While rolling the pipe in the kneeling position, the blast nozzle engaged. They sustained an abrasion of the right inner thigh from the abrasive blasting media contacting them at 95 PSI.
event_title: Struck by discharged object or substance

narrative_text: An employee was performing hydro excavation under a pipe rack when he slipped and fell. The water nozzle contacted his neck, resulting in a laceration.
event_title: Fall on same level resulting in exposure or contact

narrative_text: An employee was performing maintenance on equipment while pressuring the unit up to the correct PSI. His hand was on top of the equipment when the air punctured his hand.
event_title: Struck by discharged object or substance

narrative_text: An employee was working with a crew on the rig floor tripping pipe into the hole. They applied the manual tongs as and the line that supplied air to the clutch froze. When the driller started the draw works forward, the rotary turned unexpectedly. One of the snub lines, which anchor the tongs in place, was secured to the rig but not to the tongs. The tongs turned and struck the worker in the chest and the employee sustained collapsed lungs, a bruised liver and kidneys, a damaged spleen, and broken ribs.
event_title: Struck by swinging or slipping object, other than handheld, n.e.c.

narrative_text: On May 15, 2025, an employee was cutting down steel mesh and debris that was protruding from a milled roadway. As the employee began to cut a piece of steel with an angle grinder, he steadied himself with his left hand and the tool contacted the top of his left wrist, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
event_title: Struck by running powered equipment  n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was standing on the floor plate of a drilling rig when the method of attaching the floor plate to the structure failed. The employee fell 17 feet to the ground, suffering a head laceration that required surgery.
event_title: Fall from collapsing structure or equipment 16 to 20 feet

narrative_text: An employee was cleaning wet sand from the sand bin gate when the gate closed on his left hand, causing multiple fractures and lacerations. He required sutures.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative_text: Two employees were attempting to clear a clog from a cellar with a water hose. As they moved the hose into the cellar, an obstruction came out and pushed the hose out.  The hose whipped around, striking both employees in the face, causing lacerations and facial bone fractures.
event_title: Struck by swinging or slipping object, other than handheld, n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was assisting in hydroblasting operations and received a laceration to the left calf when the water cutting machine malfunctioned.
event_title: Struck by discharged object or substance

narrative_text: An employee was walking on the beam portion of the pumping unit attempting to guide the "horse's head" into position when the "horses-head" moved unexpectedly and struck the employee's right foot resulting in a fracture and laceration to the foot.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation

narrative_text: An employee was operating power tongs and running casing into a hole. The CRT tool fell 40 feet from the top drive striking the casing stump and the employee. The employee suffered four amputated toes on their right foot and a puncture wound on their back and was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

narrative_text: An employee was checking the air trap and noticed some shell cuttings were clogging up the trap. He was walking around to wash them out when he walked through some steam and did not see the step down. He fell onto the metal grated floor, landing on his left hip and left knee. The employee was hospitalized and required hip surgery.
event_title: Other fall to lower level  unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was walking alongside a burned-out truck that was being moved into a yard by a tow truck. The employee's right foot passed in front of the driver's side tire rim, and the tire ran over the employee's steel-toed footwear. The employee suffered a lacerated little toe, a broken middle toe, and another laceration.
event_title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was holding a pup joint when a catwalk pushed the joint forward, causing it to strike their upper body. The employee suffered four broken ribs, internal bleeding from the pancreas, and bruises to their stomach and chest.
event_title: Struck by propelled, falling, or suspended object  unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was cutting fabric with a knife when the knife stabbed the employee's leg.
event_title: Injured by object held or wielded by person

narrative_text: An employee climbed the steps of a work platform to inspect the passenger side of a pump trailer that was leaking. As he was descending from the platform, he slipped and fell into a sitting position on top of a bracket that went through his coveralls and punctured the inside of his right thigh.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was disassembling a wire-line tool when a section of the tooling fell onto the employee's hand. The employee sustained deep lacerations to four fingers and small fractures to two fingers, requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

narrative_text: An employee was lowering a well pump down a well shaft when a 1/2-inch cable snapped and whipped back up, striking the employee. He suffered lacerations to both hands and bruising on the chest, requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

narrative_text: An employee was helping to unstring a drill line when the drill line became hung up in the fast line. The drill line then came free, striking and lacerating the employee's right thigh.
event_title: Struck by object or equipment, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was standing on the rig floor when a chain broke while cement was being piped into the casing. The broken chain struck the employee on the hard hat resulting in a laceration and a possible eye socket fracture.
event_title: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

narrative_text: An employee was exiting a pick-up truck bed when he fell backward off the rear bumper to the ground, resulting in a subdural hematoma.
event_title: Other fall to lower level  less than 6 feet

narrative_text: On or about 4/29/15, an employee's index finger on right hand was amputated while cutting a 2 x 6 wood slab on a table saw. The employee was hospitalized. The employee's 4th and 5th digits on the right hand were repaired as well.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation

narrative_text: An employee was restarting a compressor when he bumped into the side of a staircase and suffered a bruised leg. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck against stationary object  n.e.c.

narrative_text: An employee was swapping out sides of a choke manifold during drill out operations when the threaded end of a 10K needle valve parted from the end cap and struck the employee causing a laceration to the right leg.
event_title: Struck by discharged object or substance

narrative_text: An employee was hydroblasting the tubes in a spare condenser with a lance. As he moved the lance from one tube to the next, the lance engaged, jumped back, and lacerated the employee's right hand.
event_title: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by injured worker

narrative_text: An employee was working outside in a rail car cleaning process area. The employee began to suffer heat-related muscle cramps and was hospitalized.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was on top of a haul truck trailer, taking tiedowns for a pumping unit's crank guard to be lifted with a crank. The employee fell approximately 5 feet off the trailer and landed on one foot, resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula, which caused a muscle injury. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
event_title: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet

narrative_text: Employee was burned from his knees up to his lower abdomen after removing the strainer for maintenance on the Scott Unit.
event_title: Exposure to harmful substances or environments, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee had been assisting with a pipe weld. During clean-up operations, he began experiencing muscle cramps and shortness of breath. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee experienced muscle cramps while rigging up isolation tools. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: On April 19, 2019, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was breaking down pipe with a sledge hammer when he threw out his back and experienced lower back pain. He was hospitalized with a herniated disk at the L4 and L5 vertebrae.
event_title: Overexertion in holding, carrying, or wielding-single episode

narrative_text: An employee tripped and twisted his ankle while stepping down from a machine. He suffered a displaced fracture to the right fibula and a sprained ligament in the right ankle.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was walking the floor when a fork truck backed up and struck the employee resulting in foot fractures and a sprained knee.
event_title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle backing up in nonroadway area

narrative_text: An employee was hospitalized for complications due to a muscle injury after working on the battery.
event_title: Nonclassifiable

narrative_text: On May 24, 2017, at approximately 9:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to isolate a pump and needed to clean the strainer basket. After opening the system, the employee was hit with steam, suffering second degree burns and requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Contact with hot objects or substances

narrative_text: While an employee descended a wooden stair case, a stair tread began to give way. The employee shifted his weight to the handrail and the handrail gave way, causing the employee to fall approximately two feet to the ground. The employee landed on his back, then slid down the hill and contacted a concrete barrier. The employee was hospitalized with lower back pain.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative_text: An employee was cleaning a clogged strainer on a pump. Upon removal of the strainer, stored up steam was released and burned the employee's face, chest and right arm.
event_title: Contact with hot objects or substances

narrative_text: An employee was using a crack cleaning machine equipped with a wire brush to remove grass and debris from cracks in the roadway. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after experiencing muscle cramps.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was performing servicing operations at a well site when he experienced lower back pain due to water intoxication and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: After performing general maintenance around a plant, an employee started experiencing muscle spasms and was hospitalized for a possible heat stress injury.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was on a scissor lift using a manual 2-inch hand threader, threading a piece of pipe to put a valve on. He strained his back, suffering a herniated disk.
event_title: Overexertion in pushing, pulling, or turning-single episode

narrative_text: An employee opened an access panel on a pipe rattler unit to adjust the pipe by hand. His right hand made contact with the pipe cleaning brush, which was still energized at the time, rubbing the skin on his hand away to the muscle layer.
event_title: Struck against moving part of machinery or equipment

narrative_text: An employee was mixing mud when he began to feel dizzy due to dehydration from the heat.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: On or about 7/6/16, at 17:45 hours, an employee had been working outside at several oilfield locations in high heat conditions when he began feeling ill and collapsed. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was tripping pipe out of a hole on a 96 F day when he passed out due to heat exhaustion.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was performing well test operations and experienced heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was defrosting a valve using methanol. The valve ruptured and sprayed methanol on the employee's flame-resistant clothing, causing skin irritation.
event_title: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue

narrative_text: An employee was monitoring a shaker during an outdoor shift when they suffered dehydration due to heat exposure, resulting in kidney failure and hospitalization.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat  outdoor

narrative_text: An employee experienced cramps and difficulty breathing after rigging up on location, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee was retrieving a dust cap from an asphalt auger when his right ring fingertip was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Struck by running powered equipment  during maintenance, cleaning, testing

narrative_text: At the facility shop area, an employee tripped over his feet and fell on an industrial sized valve stem used in hydrofracking (a piece of sharp equipment) and lacerated his abdomen.  This injury required hospitalization for two days.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over self

narrative_text: An employee was driving a powered industrial truck  when it struck a pillar. The employee was ejected and his head came into contact with the structure of the truck. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
event_title: Part of occupant s body caught between vehicle and other object in nonroadway transport incident

narrative_text: On July 1, 2024, an employee was assisting in water well drilling operations when he began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat-related dehydration.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat  outdoor

narrative_text: An employee was repairing a meter run and began to experience cramping. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative_text: An employee had been training and running casing. After returning to the office he was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat
